text:
lena: Quick launch handshake thread  we need one-bullet owners for each GA boundary: SLA applicability language, private-deploy quickstart, billing-adjudication flow, monitoring SLOs/runbooks, and pilot-burst terms. Toss up answers here so I can lock the checklist.

maya: I want the doc surface to clearly separate GA promises (what we contractually back for Dedicated, what we SLO for Hosted) from pilot concessions. Also want a single "SLA scope" banner that points to model + seq-length rules.

eli: I'll own the SLA wording + matrix. Plan: compact table with columns: model_family | max_input_tokens | coverage (Y/N) | p50/p95/p99 targets. Will include an explicit clause: "SLA covers Redwood-verified models with input length <= 1024 tokens; other requests are best-effort." ETA: Wed EOD.

sophia: Docs owner for private deploy quickstart + KMS/HSM snippet + audit-log query samples. Will add a short "What the SLA covers" banner in the quickstart and a troubleshooting section that links to runbooks. ETA: Thu AM.

noah: Ops: I'll draft the billing-adjudication flow and update the oncall rota. Proposal: billing-oncall 24h ack -> gather traces + per-route cost data -> product-policy decision within 72h -> finance issues credits. I'll also add a per-route "cost-per-minute" metric to the dashboard. ETA: Fri noon.

jamie: Observability: I'll set up synthetic p99 probes for top-5 routes, rollout-correlation dashboards, and the token-cost spike alert (suggest +30% over 5m). Will attach runbook skeleton. ETA: Thu EOD.

finance-bot: For pilot burst credits we require explicit expiry language. Recommend clause: "Pilot credits are promotional, non-transferable, and may be revoked with 30 days' notice; unused credits do not entitle to refunds." I'll prepare sample contract wording and an example consumption table. ETA: Thu.

legal-bot: Confirm: avoid absolute uptime promises for Hosted; Dedicated may have contractual latency tiers with capped credits. We'll review Eli's SLA draft within 48h of posting.

lena: Monitoring thresholds proposed by Jamie: synthetic p99 step-up >20% vs baseline for 10m, client error-rate >0.5% for 5m, token-cost-per-minute spike >30% for 5m. Eli/Noah will own runbooks + escalation mapping.

eli: I'll own latency runbooks. Short play: 1) validate via 1m/5m windows, 2) check recent rollouts and model variants, 3) rollback candidate, 4) scale dedicated pool or page eng-runtime. Will attach to alerts.

sophia: Docs will include a troubleshooting appendix that cross-references the runbook steps (with example CLI commands and audit queries). I'll request a reviewer tomorrow.

noah: I'll add the rota entry and ensure Billing-Oncall has access to the per-route dashboard tiles. Will document escalation contacts in ops playbook.

maya: Acceptance checklist for flip (owners):
- SLA matrix + legal-reviewed text (eli + legal-bot)
- Private-deploy quickstart & KMS examples merged (sophia)
- Monitoring alerts + runbooks live (jamie + eli)
- Billing adjudication flow + per-route metrics (noah)
- Pilot-burst contract clause + finance signoff (finance-bot)
Reply with "ack + ETA" if you accept.

sophia: ack Thu AM (docs PR).

eli: ack Wed EOD (SLA draft).

jamie: ack Thu EOD (alerts + probes).

noah: ack Fri noon (billing flow + rota).

maya: ack contingent on legal review (legal-bot).

finance-bot: ack Thu EOD (contract draft).

legal-bot: ack 48h after Eli posts draft.

deploy-bot: Reminder: final staging smoke at 2025-11-06T15:00Z includes synthetic p99 probes and billing smoke tests. :robot_face: 

lena: Great  I'll update the launch checklist and tag owners. If anything slips, call it out here; otherwise we plan to flip the GA flag after smoke passes. :rocket:
